FN-84W3622-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 280
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 280 as introduced could increase receipts to certain counties, municipalities, and
public institutions of higher education by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of
court cost, attorney fees, and court-ordered compensation for expenses incurred related to the
abatement of certain public nuisances.
